root.str: Hot dog! You won’t regret this! I promise!
…That’s not a legally binding guarantee by the way.
Well, if you change your mind you can find the deal in the premium item menu.
Although I don't get paid a commission when you buy it that way.
Hey, has Ol' Gil got a Black Friday sale for you!
You probably don’t need it, or even want it -- heck, it may not even be that good of deal.
But it’s Black Friday, so you'll think it is. And you'll buy it!
Please buy it.
But hey, at least you’ll always have that toaster and every time you see it… *Sob*
Anyway, has Gil got a Black Friday deal for you!
You probably don’t need it, or even want it, but it’s Black Friday, so you have to buy it…
Gil bought that toaster on credit Gil doesn’t have!
Here’s some stuff that has nothing to do with Thanksgiving but you definitely want to buy anyway!
Including Duffman, Duff Brewery, Springfield Sign, and $50,000!
A new item offer every hour! Check back often!
Buy limited time sale items and get donut rebates right on the spot!
Is the Duff supply safe?
Oh yea!
Thank you giant Sky Finger, you’ve saved our Springfield!
Can’t get enough Duff? Brew more today!
Jumpstart your Springfield with:
Hey. HEY! Yes, you! The Sky finger.
If you let this town run out of Duff, you’ll be sorry!
There’s probably enough Duff stockpiled to last any normal city a 50 years!
But what about Springfield!?
You sir, do you enjoy a Duff?
Well, I have been known to enjoy a celebratory glass on occasion.
Did you realize that no one is brewing it anymore in Springfield? We could run out at any time!
Ahh-hh!
It worked. It actually worked. You bought something!
This happens less than 2% of the time!
Improve your reception with a huge broadcast dish!
“Unlock a new Broadcast Job for Channel 6!”
“Bonus: Burning bush, set on fire by microwaves!”
50 Donut Value!
*sigh* I really felt that one getting away from me.
Oh man, how am I supposed to pitch a Broadcast Dish and a burning bush?
Umm, how about—
Can we get satellite radio with that dish?
Umm, sure! Why not?
Special Offer!
Really? Well hot damn! The kids are going to eat tonight!
Day Old Donuts! They don't taste as good, but they purchase premium content just fine.
Donuts Up to 25% Off!
25% More Donuts!
C'mon, Gil really needs this. They're going to take my kidney!
Ol' Gil's got a real sweet treat for you today, Springfield.
Day Old Donuts!
Mmm… donuts.
You're not really planning to eat those stale donuts, are you?
No, I'm going to use them to purchase Professor Frink, have him build a time machine, then travel back in time to when the donuts were still fresh. And then eat them.
I'm sorry I said all those mean things about you, Gil.
Aw, it's fine. Maybe you can buy me a Duff next time I come back.
Don't come back.
Get the Duff Brewery, complete with its manic corporate shill, Duffman!
Including $50,000, Springfield Sign, Duffman and Duff Brewery!
Well, if you change your mind you can find the deal in your premium item menu.
Although I don't get paid a commission when you buy it that way.
Okay, Gil. Just like you rehearsed.
Excuse me, fine sir--
No, not you again! You're the most annoying thing in this town!
You know everyone hates you, right?
They do? Why?
Because you're an ad. We're people, who do funny things and earn money. But you're just an ad.
Aw, jeez. I'm just trying to pay for my kid's braces… the walking kind, not the teeth kind.
Ugh, fine. But whatever you're selling, I'm not interested.
The Duff Brewery, complete with Duffman.
Really?
Gil, you're the greatest! I love you, I love you, I love you…
Let's hear it for science, mm-hai!
Shut up, nerd! *punch*
Who wouldn't want an awkward nerd in their town?
And get all this other stuff!
Including: Frink’s Lab, Professor Frink, $50 000 and Homer Buddha.
490 Donut Value!
It’s that kind of disinterest in science that's keeping us from going to Mars!
Scientists! Get your scientists here!
You can't sell the creation of a scientist! Only graduate schools can do that.
Please little girl, I've been trapped alone for so long in a plane of existence that only I understand. I just want to come back and be trapped alone in my laboratory.
Ice Cream Truck
That's good work, Gil. Now to enslave the human race and make you all work in my mines.
Oh boy, a job!
Nothing says, “I’m in charge” like a giant super laser!
Including: Volcano Lair, evil super genius Hank Scorpio and Springfield Sign.
370 Donut Value!
Come on! Don't you want to protect your town from those Columbians?
Heya Springfield! Are you tired of “the man” telling you what to do?
Which man?
The man in Washington!
Which Washington?
Well, now you can stand up to our government by scrawling your city name across a mountain and protecting it with a death ray!
Cause there's Washington state and the District of Columbia… which is kind of weird. Isn't Columbia another country?
Yeah, that is weird.
This just in, annoying sales person Gil Gunderson WAS NOT beaten to a pulp by angry loan sharks. Now this reporter has seen it all.
Free Mystery Box with every News Van!
46 Donut Value!
Oh, who am I kidding? There was probably only a shrub in that box. I mean it could have been a been something really cool, but what are the chances of that?
You there, you look like you could use a Channel 6 News Van!
Why the hell would we want that?
Umm, because I’ll throw in what’s ever is in this Mystery Box!
Mystery Boxes, my Chilli’s heel.
Dad, I think you mean Achilles’ heel.
Chilli… *drools*
Really? You want it? Hot damn!
Yep, that’s right. And it’ll cost you if you want to keep warming yourself at MY tire fire.
Ow, What have I done?
Keep warm while stargazing with the warm glow of burning tires.
Includes the Tire Yard and Springfield Observatory!
115 Donut Value!
Aw, common Homer. Don’t let your little girl down -- don’t be like Gil.
I’m OK actually. The tire fire would have been terrible for the environment.
You’re such a brave little environmentalist.
Environmentalist? NOOOO!
Have you ever wonder what lies beyond the heavens?
No, not really.
But I have!
Hrm. Think quickly Gil, you’re almost there.
Homer, have you ever warmed yourself by a burning tire on a cold night?
On occasion.
Well then I’ve got a deal for the both of you! …I hope.
Oh boy, I didn’t think I had any chance of selling that. What with the smell!
Ugh, not so loud man.
For Sale: One slightly crashed school bus with slightly used driver included!
Also has $5000 stashed in the seats.
160 Donut Value!
I can’t say I blame you. Otto’d probably just hang out on your coach all day, and eat everything in your fridge. Hey, maybe you’d buy me instead?
For sale: One slightly crashed school bus with $5000 cash back!
What’s that smell?
Uh, my head.
Oh. For Sale: One slightly crashed school bus, with $5000 cash back! Driver included.
You bought something? Man, I can't wait to tell the guys at the shelter!
But don’t stop there, I could really use a home run with this one.
Premium Decorations -- they look as great as they earn bonus money!
Up to 30% Off!
Aw, come on. Not even a white picket segment?
I could really use the commission.
Is your town a little down?
Could you use a fancy new bench, fruit tree or Tire Fire?
For some reason that makes no sense, having them in your town lets you earn more money!

You gotta spend money to make money
-- real money to make fake money!
Fans of Krusty, have I got a treat for you!
Get the studio where his show is recorded, as well as his side-kick Sideshow Mel and a cannon to shoot him from!
Can I get Krusty too?
Umm, no. He's a regular character. You probably already have him.
Oh, right. He does that thing with the giant exclamation point -- I remember now.
Well, can I have some other premium character? Like a random one that has nothing to do with Krusty or his studios?
But that wouldn't make any sense.
I'm walking away…
Okay, okay!
Egad! Where are you planning to shoot me with that cannon?
High, everybody!
No problem. There's still plenty of cheese on the inside of that pizza box I found earlier.
Get the Krusty Premium package… for some reason with Dr. Nick!
Includes Krustylu Studios, Sideshow Mel, a Cannon and the “Doctor”.
Honey, I made a sale! Tell the kids I'll be home for Christmas!
What do you mean I'm not welcome?
You got remarried already?!
Celebrate consumerism with this holiday inspired theme park and tree!
275 Donut Value!
Including: Santa’s Village, Holiday Tree and Santa Homer!
Hi, honey? I need you to tell the kids Christmas is cancelled again this year.
Is that a man’s voice I hear?
What? No… come on, it’s Christmas. I even have money this year.
Ho-ho-ho, just wait until you see what I’ve got for you today.
Is it a pony?
Is it a large screen TV? 'Cause I could stop breaking in to the Brown House if I had one of those.
Oh boy, oh boy, you're back! Come on Gil, don't screw this up again.
Saw something that caught your eye, eh? Please don't leave again.
Please buy something this time. I'm going to lose my kids!
A second chance? Oh thank you, thank you, thank you.
Your back? Your back! I can't hardly believe it.
Alright Gil. You can maybe do it this time.
Oh god, please let me sell something this time.
You have no idea how much I need this.
Please buy something, I can't sell anymore blood. Uwooh…
WELcoME. I'VE lost CONtrol of my vOICe tAKING experiMENTAL DRUGS!
Come on, doesn't Gil get a lick?
Help Gil out. I don't have the back to be a cat burglar.
Oh wow! A customer!
Don't mind the bleeding, I was just with my bookie.
C'mon, help ol'Gil out here!
Take a look… please! I can't afford another divorce.
Just one more sale and I'll finally have that hot plate paid for.
If you won't buy something, can you at least push me in front of an expensive looking car?
Don't get my hopes up, I can't take another rejection.
I'm just trying to earn enough money to buy my real eyes back.
Alright Gil, remember… ABCD: Always Be Closing Donuts!
Try Lady Duff today! She's mean, she's lean… she's the beer queen. OH YEAH!
That part about me not getting paid wasn’t true, right?
Squeaky Voice Teen works for you, but you get to keep money!
Heeey!
You’ll also get his belongings: Mystery Box, 25 Donuts, $5000
You’ll also get his belongings:
Mystery Box, 25 Donuts, $5000
Squeaky Voice Teen works for you, but you get to keep money!
How can you deny that oily, pimply face a thankless life in your Springfield?
Got a crummy job that no grown person would be willing to do? Well, then get yourself a teen!
A handsome teenaged boy, who's smart but misunderstood because he plays by his own rules?
No, a Squeaky-Voiced Teen. He's none of those things!
Phew.
Yippie! A sale!
Kids, we’re going to go see a movie, and daddy will even buy you each a donut!
What do your mother said I’m not supposed to call you!?
What’s better than donuts and a movie?
205 Donut Value!
Where’s my movie and donuts? I’m holding you responsible Gil!
Oh boy.
Springfield, maybe you’d like to get a few new buildings?
Pssh! That sounds like work.
No no, come back! Make the sky finger do all the work. Then you can catch a movie, or eat donuts whenever you want.
You heard him Sky finger. Don’t let me down.
Mmm… extra donuts.
Should we set some out for Santa?
No way! The only fat guy getting his hands on these is me.
Celebrate the season with even more donuts!
Get 25% More Donuts with every Pack!
Ah, jeez! Guess the kids will have to go the another Christmas without presents… or electricity.
If I can’t sell donuts in Springfield, I’m ruined!
Ho-ho-ho boy. Have I got a Christmas miracle for you!
To celebrate the season, all donut packages come with 25% more donuts!

Which means a dozen is now 15. 50 is the new 40! And that tray of 132 donuts is now… well, Ol Gil's not that good at math. If he was, he wouldn't have to be standing out here in the cold hawking donuts.
He's also not that good at grammar, always calling himself he instead of I…
Do you know how many jobs the sky finger has made me do this year!?
Fine, I'll look at the store. Just shut up already!
Bless you, fat sir.
Holiday donuts… Get 'em while they are still appropriate to the season!
Holidays 2013 Donut Bonus
Holiday donuts! Get your holiday donuts! Available exclusively here from ol' Gil!
Gil?! You're the guy who snapped up all those holiday donuts?
Yup! And I've got so many of them I'll be selling them for months… at an inflated price, of course!
Months? But no one is going to want to buy holiday donuts after Christmas.
Oh, I didn't think of that. Gil's really stepped in it this time. Do you think my donut surplus will hold until next year?
Nobody's going to buy year-old donuts, Gil. Also, who's going to still be playing this game in a year?
Oh God, you're right. I need to sell my entire supply before the bottom falls out of the market. I have to cut my price, take a loss… how about bonus donuts with every purchase?
*snickers* It's the Hunt brothers all over again.
Every sale I make is a loss! Even when you buy my stuff, you're killing ol' Gil here.
Aw jeez, I really need this. It will determine what level of bankruptcy I have to file after the holidays.
